context: M17 o6. (Nick.) Eleni steps out of her glass office with the club's figures, written on a napkin.

lines.speaker: char.eleni_varelas
lines.text: Nikos, I read her numbers. They balance. Ours don't.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Eleni, she's a… she works on Eighth Avenue.

lines.speaker: char.eleni_varelas
lines.text: And you work on Thirtieth Street and owe the bank nine hundred coats.

lines.speaker: char.eleni_varelas
lines.text: In this family I'm the one who reads. Give her the lease after the season.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: After the season. If there's a season.
